title: Identification of autoantibodies as potential non-invasive biomarkers for intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
summary: Random-forest feature selection on measured serum autoantibody profiles identifies a candidate three-antibody iCCA biomarker signature.
ai_technology: Protein microarrays measured 1,622 proteins in 16 iCCA and 10 matched controls; candidate signatures used leave-one-out cross-validation and were contextualized against tissue-expression data.

evidence.tested: Random-forest feature selection on measured serum autoantibody profiles identifies a candidate three-antibody iCCA biomarker signature.
evidence.unknown: Small discovery cohort and internal cross-validation support a candidate biomarker only; no prospective clinical screening utility is shown.
